districts.label: Indianapolis Airport Logistics
districts.oneLineDistinction: Large-scale warehouse and distribution on Indianapolis’s southwest side
districts.shortDescription: Indianapolis Airport Logistics is the City-owned industrial geography around Park Fletcher, Stout Field and the airport-side employment area. It supports conventional warehouse, distribution, service-industrial and broader operational uses, with larger-format properties and an air-cargo context. The label does not include Plainfield inventory: airport proximity and an Indianapolis mailing reference are not substitutes for municipal ownership, and exact building or transportation capabilities remain property-level questions.
whatStandsOut: Park Fletcher and Stout Field industrial identity
worthKnowing: Plainfield is a separate municipality; verify exact loading, circulation, power, yard and permitted use by property.
accessObservations: Indianapolis International Airport’s cargo facilities and providers operate within the airport employment area.

districts.label: Park 100 / Northwest Indianapolis
districts.oneLineDistinction: Established business-park mix from warehouses to office/flex
districts.shortDescription: Park 100 is an established northwest Indianapolis business-park district with conventional industrial buildings, office/warehouse properties and smaller multi-tenant flex formats. Contractors, service operations, distributors and businesses needing both office and operational space commonly compare it with Airport Logistics. Its building range is part of the district’s identity: Park 100 should not be reduced to either small flex units or large warehouses alone.
worthKnowing: Unit size, office ratio, loading and permitted use vary substantially between properties.

districts.label: Park Fletcher / Stout Field
districts.oneLineDistinction: Named industrial components within the Airport Logistics geography
districts.shortDescription: Park Fletcher and Stout Field are City-recognized southwest Indianapolis areas that help explain the finer-grained structure inside Airport Logistics. Industrial and research-park properties, warehouses and service operations occupy this component geography near Bradbury Road and the airport employment area. It appears here as public context—not as a third Recommendation Intelligence peer—and should not be expanded across the municipal line into Plainfield.
whatStandsOut: Official Park Fletcher and Stout Field identities
worthKnowing: Use this component to understand Airport Logistics, not as an independently ranked recommendation district.
